notes.TWN: 勞工保險條例第 58 條：保險年資滿 15 年、年滿 60 歲可以請領老年年金，2018 年起逐步提高，2024 年 64 歲、2026 年起 65 歲（男女相同）；勞動基準法第 54 條的 65 歲是雇主可以強制退休的年齡。台灣不在 OECD 的資料裡，定義不完全相同

notesEn.TWN: Labour Insurance Act, Art. 58: an old-age pension can be claimed at 60 with 15 years of contributions, rising from 2018 to 64 in 2024 and 65 from 2026 (same for women and men); the 65 in Art. 54 of the Labour Standards Act is the age at which employers may require retirement. Taiwan is not in the OECD data, so definitions differ somewhat
